new_failure_mode: CSID can avoid double-counting safeguards that share the same declared evidence_family yet still overstate independence when differently named evidence families are driven by a common supported covariance channel.
non_additive_interaction: SACPS covariance changes CSID's equivalence partition over safeguard evidence families; that changes multiplicative coverage, residual-loss evaluation and the selected portfolio while costs, coverage inputs and budget are fixed.
mechanism_removing_comparator: same CSID problem using only the original declared evidence_family labels, with covariance-based cross-family merging removed

nearest_existing_products.difference: SCCATF adds covariance cross-terms to an allocation objective; SCIG changes the independence/equivalence partition that determines how safeguard coverage composes before portfolio evaluation.
SCOPG uses support geometry as an identification guard; SCIG uses an executable SACPS covariance estimate to revise common-mode evidence structure inside a safeguard portfolio.

strengths: directly addresses a documented CSID product boundary/common-mode assumption
mechanism-removing control revalues the control portfolio under the candidate dependence reality
exact collapse when no supported cross-family dependence exists
weaknesses: dependence support and correlation threshold are externally supplied/calibrated
grouping by a hard dependence component is conservative and does not model graded copula dependence
working_region: cross-family evidence channels have strong supported dependence that invalidates label-only independence
failure_region: wrong support or poorly calibrated threshold can merge genuinely independent safeguards or miss common-mode dependence; ambiguous threshold cases abstain
router_fallback_abstention: ABSTAIN_DEPENDENCE_THRESHOLD_AMBIGUOUS preserves the original CSID partition as an explicit caller-selected fallback rather than silently choosing a merge
standalone_role: design a safeguard portfolio after correcting nominal evidence-family independence with support-aware covariance
component_role: emit a dependence-adjusted evidence-family map and audited portfolio for downstream contract/control selection
